purpose: Translate the six audited Stage78 local move-BQMs into binary Dirac-3 polynomial jobs, validate the translation locally, and freeze a free-allocation hardware protocol without contacting QCI during preparation.

translation.logical_variables: Stage78 swap-move indicators m000...; the all-zero vector is already the frozen classical warm solution, so the proposed XOR warm-start transformation is the identity.
translation.constant_term_policy: Omit the BQM offset because Dirac-3 does not accept constant polynomial terms; restore it during local double-precision energy recomputation.
translation.coefficient_scaling: Divide every nonconstant coefficient by the maximum absolute nonconstant coefficient for that instance.
translation.classification_energy: Always recompute with the frozen Stage78 float64 BQM; never classify from device-reported energy.

preflight.operation: Authenticate and call get_allocations only; do not upload a polynomial and do not submit a device job.

calibration.selection_order: Highest recomputed strict-improvement fraction, highest exact-optimum fraction, lowest best guarded float64 energy, highest feasible fraction, lowest recorded device usage, then lowest schedule number.

confirmation.primary_endpoint: Both positive instances must return at least one feasible strict improvement and no sample below the certified optimum; every negative must return zero recomputed strict improvements and no sample below the certified optimum.

hardware_protocol.device_safety_interlock: Calibration and confirmation each require both --authorize-qci-device and STAGE79_QCI_ACK=I_ACCEPT_STAGE79_QCI_DEVICE_USAGE.
hardware_protocol.claim_boundary: This is a cross-hardware physical optimization PoC. It is not a quantum-advantage, scaling, biological-generalization, drug-discovery, or end-to-end speedup experiment.

interpretation_boundary: Stage79 preserves the Stage78 local move search and exact references, changes only the physical backend representation, and stops before all external QCI access.
